scope: Independent security and logic re-review of corrected activation helper and safety regressions
supersedes: The activation-helper optimization/partial-I/O finding in integration-independent-review.json; original art/integration evidence review remains intact.

verified.settings_validation: One append, no duplicates on repeat, unrelated values retained, customized/reordered/duplicate selections rejected
verified.atomic_replacement: Same-directory temporary file; complete bytes flushed and fsynced before os.replace; temporary cleanup checked
verified.rollback_failure: Explicit RuntimeError with chained original activation error
verified.main_wiring: Static review confirms all candidates validated before writes; backups read back and retained; settings/catalogue/receipt applied in one rollback-capable transaction

suggestions: Persist the additional independent temporary failure probes as permanent tests in future helper work.
limitations: Rollback covers caught exceptions, not cross-file crash atomicity or concurrent external writers.
Helper main/backup wiring inspected statically, not executed by reviewer.
